Khu Thú Ăn Thịt.name: Carnivore Zone
Khu Thú Ăn Thịt.description: This zone cares for and conserves powerful predators such as lions, white Bengal tigers, Indochinese tigers and leopards.

Khu Chuồng Voi.name: Elephant Enclosure
Khu Chuồng Voi.description: The elephants live in a spacious enclosure near the giraffes, beside the river.

Khu Vực Linh Trưởng & Thú Nhỏ.name: Primates and Small Mammals Area
Khu Vực Linh Trưởng & Thú Nhỏ.description: The natural home of monkeys, gibbons and many lively small mammals.

Khu Bò Sát.name: Reptile Zone
Khu Bò Sát.description: Home to pythons, snakes, crocodiles and rare tropical turtles.

Vườn Lan & Xương Rồng.name: Orchid and Cactus Garden
Vườn Lan & Xương Rồng.description: Located to the left of the main stage, this cool green garden is a popular photo spot.

Khu Vui Chơi Giải Trí (Đu Quay).name: Amusement Area
Khu Vui Chơi Giải Trí (Đu Quay).description: An area with thrill rides and outdoor play spaces for children.
